mu_name_from: MuMain loads armour indexes 10 to 14 from ArmorElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 149: `AccessModel(MODEL_ARMOR + i + 10, ..., L"ArmorElf", i + 1)`), so index 11 is ArmorElf02, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Silk Armor. Group 8 index 11, Player/ArmorElf02.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's second set, and the first one she can buy: Elf Lala in Noria carries all five pieces at +2 (src/sim/market.cpp, kElfLala, the index-11 rows). Here so that her shelf shows the pieces it sells rather than their names.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. The sheets are violet quilted fabric with gold flourishes painted into it, which is the Pad set's reading - stuffed cloth, not a plate - in the elf's colours. See profiles/soft_armour.json.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 81. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateArmor(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)`, so slot 2 is group 7, 3 is 8 and 4 is 9.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. 70 agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/upper_07.OZJ (128x128), hide.jpg and skin_warrior_01.OZJ (256x256), from MuMain. The .bmd names upper_07.jpg, hide.jpg and skin_warrior_01.jpg; 88 of the 156 triangles are on the first, 8 on hide and 60 on the skin.
sheet_note: upper_07 is a violet quilted bodice with gold scrolls down the breast and a pair of gilt wing-like flourishes at each shoulder, painted into the cloth rather than modelled. Mean (128, 105, 97) at chroma 46. skin_warrior_01 is the elf's own body sheet, which the piece carries because the set leaves her arms bare. hide is MU capping the openings, a solid black square, as on ArmorElf01.
material_note: Five islands and two answers. Islands 2, 3 and 4 are 16, 22 and 22 - 60 together, which is skin_warrior_01's 60 exactly - and sit in the body sheet's torso and limb columns, as the Vine Armor's three do: the bare arms, skin. Islands 0 and 1 are 6 and 90, 96 together, which is upper_07's 88 and hide's 8: the bodice and its caps, cloth over the profile's leather. The gold scrolls and shoulder flourishes are painted into the violet quilting rather than laid over it as a plate, which is what separates this from the Pad Gloves' brass; majority is violet fabric.
